results.name: Fintype.sum_equiv
results.source_text:
@[to_additive /-- `Fintype.sum_equiv` is a specialization of `Finset.sum_bij` that
automatically fills in most arguments.

See `Equiv.sum_comp` for a version without `h`. -/]
lemma prod_equiv (e : ι ≃ κ) (f : ι → M) (g : κ → M) (h : ∀ x, f x = g (e x)) :
    ∏ x, f x = ∏ x, g x := prod_bijective _ e.bijective _ _ h
results.docstring:
`Fintype.sum_equiv` is a specialization of `Finset.sum_bij` that
automatically fills in most arguments.

See `Equiv.sum_comp` for a version without `h`.

results.name: Sym.equivNatSumOfFintype
results.source_text:
/-- The `n`th symmetric power of a finite type `α` is naturally equivalent to the subtype of maps
`α → ℕ` with total mass `n`.

See also `Sym.equivNatSum` when `α` is not necessarily finite. -/
noncomputable def equivNatSumOfFintype [Fintype α] :
    Sym α n ≃ {P : α → ℕ // ∑ i, P i = n} :=
  (equivNatSum α n).trans <| Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.subtypeEquiv <| by simp [Finsupp.sum_fintype]
results.docstring:
The `n`th symmetric power of a finite type `α` is naturally equivalent to the subtype of maps
`α → ℕ` with total mass `n`.

See also `Sym.equivNatSum` when `α` is not necessarily finite.

results.name: Equiv
results.source_text:
/-- `α ≃ β` is the type of functions from `α → β` with a two-sided inverse. -/
structure Equiv (α β : Sort*) where
  /-- The forward map of an equivalence.

  Do NOT use directly. Use the coercion instead. -/
  protected toFun : α → β
  /-- The backward map of an equivalence.

  Do NOT use `e.invFun` directly. Use the coercion of `e.symm` instead. -/
  protected invFun : β → α
  protected left_inv : LeftInverse invFun toFun := by intro; first | rfl | ext <;> rfl
  protected right_inv : RightInverse invFun toFun := by intro; first | rfl | ext <;> rfl
results.docstring: `α ≃ β` is the type of functions from `α → β` with a two-sided inverse.

results.name: Equiv.psigmaCongrRight
results.source_text:
/-- A family of equivalences `Π a, β₁ a ≃ β₂ a` generates an equivalence between `Σ' a, β₁ a` and
`Σ' a, β₂ a`. -/
@[simps (attr := grind =) apply]
def psigmaCongrRight {β₁ β₂ : α → Sort*} (F : ∀ a, β₁ a ≃ β₂ a) : (Σ' a, β₁ a) ≃ Σ' a, β₂ a where
  toFun a := ⟨a.1, F a.1 a.2⟩
  invFun a := ⟨a.1, (F a.1).symm a.2⟩
  left_inv := by grind
  right_inv := by grind
results.docstring:
A family of equivalences `Π a, β₁ a ≃ β₂ a` generates an equivalence between `Σ' a, β₁ a` and
`Σ' a, β₂ a`.

results.name: KroneckerDelta.kroneckerDelta_finSumFinEquiv
results.source_text:
/-- The Kronecker delta is invariant under the component-index equivalence `finSumFinEquiv`. -/
lemma kroneckerDelta_finSumFinEquiv (a b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    kroneckerDelta (finSumFinEquiv a) (finSumFinEquiv b) = kroneckerDelta a b := by
  simp only [kroneckerDelta, Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]
results.docstring: The Kronecker delta is invariant under the component-index equivalence `finSumFinEquiv`.

results.name: Equiv.sumEquivSigmalCond
results.source_text:
/-- An alternative form of `Equiv.sumEquivSigmaBool` where `Bool.casesOn` is replaced by `cond`. -/
def sumEquivSigmalCond : Fin m ⊕ Fin n ≃ Σ b, cond b (Fin m) (Fin n) :=
  calc Fin m ⊕ Fin n
    _ ≃ Fin n ⊕ Fin m := sumComm ..
    _ ≃ Σ b, bif b then (Fin m) else (Fin n) := sumEquivSigmaBool ..
    _ ≃ Σ b, cond b (Fin m) (Fin n) := sigmaCongrRight (fun | true | false => Equiv.refl _)
results.docstring: An alternative form of `Equiv.sumEquivSigmaBool` where `Bool.casesOn` is replaced by `cond`.

results.name: LinearMap.IsPerfPair.compl₁₂
results.source_text:
instance IsPerfPair.compl₁₂ (eM : M' ≃ₗ[R] M) (eN : N' ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    (p.compl₁₂ eM eN : M' →ₗ[R] N' →ₗ[R] R).IsPerfPair :=
  ⟨((LinearEquiv.congrLeft R R eN).symm.bijective.comp
    (IsPerfPair.bijective_left p)).comp eM.bijective,
    ((LinearEquiv.congrLeft R R eM).symm.bijective.comp
    (IsPerfPair.bijective_right p)).comp eN.bijective⟩

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.physicalProbability
results.source_text:
/-- The dimensionless physical probability density. This is is the probability density w.r.t. the
measure, obtained by dividing the phase space measure by the fundamental unit `h^dof`, making the
probability density `ρ_phys = ρ_math * h^dof` dimensionless. -/
noncomputable def physicalProbability (T : Temperature) (i : ι) : ℝ :=
  𝓒.probability T i * (𝓒.phaseSpaceunit ^ 𝓒.dof)
results.docstring:
The dimensionless physical probability density. This is is the probability density w.r.t. the
measure, obtained by dividing the phase space measure by the fundamental unit `h^dof`, making the
probability density `ρ_phys = ρ_math * h^dof` dimensionless.

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.physicalProbability_def
results.source_text:
@[simp]
lemma physicalProbability_def (T : Temperature) (i : ι) :
    𝓒.physicalProbability T i
      = 𝓒.probability T i * (𝓒.phaseSpaceunit ^ 𝓒.dof) := rfl

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.physicalProbability_congr
results.source_text:
lemma physicalProbability_congr (e : ι1 ≃ᵐ ι) (T : Temperature) (i : ι1) :
    (𝓒.congr e).physicalProbability T i
      = 𝓒.physicalProbability T (e i) := by
  simp [physicalProbability, probability]

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.log_physicalProbability
results.source_text:
lemma log_physicalProbability
    (T : Temperature) [IsFiniteMeasure (𝓒.μBolt T)] [NeZero 𝓒.μ] (i : ι) :
    Real.log (𝓒.physicalProbability T i)
      = Real.log (𝓒.probability T i) + (𝓒.dof : ℝ) * Real.log 𝓒.phaseSpaceunit := by
  rw [physicalProbability, Real.log_mul (𝓒.probability_pos T i).ne' (pow_pos 𝓒.hPos _).ne',
    Real.log_pow]

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.physicalProbability_measurable
results.source_text:
lemma physicalProbability_measurable (T : Temperature) :
    Measurable (𝓒.physicalProbability T) := by
  unfold physicalProbability probability
  fun_prop
